highlights: Result Update 4th November, 2026 BUY Target Price 815 Minda Corporation Ltd Auto Ancillary `` 1 Premiumization, EV Expansion, and Technology-Led Product Launches Driving Growth Est.
During Q2FY27, the company commenced production of panoramic sunroofs, with a typical content value of ~Rs 20,000 per vehicle, and secured its first power footstep order from an anchor PV customer.
It also secured multiple TFT instrument cluster orders (5-inch to 12-inch), with a cumulative lifetime value of >Rs 1,000 Cr and SOP commencing from FY28, largely in association with Qualcomm.

EV products contributed ~35% of new order wins, reflecting increasing customer acceptance of its technology-led solutions. • Strong Growth Visibility & Increasing EV Order Pipeline: Minda Corporation continues to secure orders across wiring harnesses, instrument clusters, vehicle access systems, switches, sunroofs, power footsteps and EV electronics, with EV platforms contributing ~35% of its order book value.
